claim_relevant_visible_text: demand for AI memory continues to rise, while the market for the conventional DRAM also starts to recover from the second half.
researcher_paraphrase: SK hynix explicitly separated continued AI-memory demand growth from an expected later recovery in conventional DRAM rather than treating them as the same demand trajectory.
precision_guard: The conventional-DRAM second-half recovery language is an April 2024 company forecast, not a realized Outcome. AI-memory demand direction and conventional recovery timing remain separate claims.
authority_boundary: SK hynix is primary for its own market outlook and product strategy, not an independent measurement of industry-wide causal shares.
